items.finding: Confidential Information is defined as any non-public information disclosed by a Party (the Disclosing Party) to the other Party (the Receiving Party) in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential. This definition is mutual and reasonable, as it applies to both parties equally.
items.quote: 2.1 **Confidential Information** means any non-public information disclosed by a Party (the **Disclosing Party**) to the other Party (the **Receiving Party**) in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential, including sales and customer data, supplier terms, pricing, product roadmaps, solution designs, source code and methodologies.

items.finding: Both parties have mutual obligations to use and disclose the Confidential Information only for the Purpose, and to protect it with at least reasonable care. The obligations are reciprocal and reasonable.
items.quote: 3.1 The Receiving Party shall: (a) use the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information only for the Purpose; (b) disclose it only to its employees, directors, professional advisers and subcontractors who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less protective than this Agreement; (c) protect it with at least reasonable care and no less care than it applies to its own confidential information; and (d) promptly notify the Disclosing Party of any unauthorised use or disclosure of which it becomes aware.

items.finding: There are no explicit rights retained by either party to use the Confidential Information after the agreement ends, except for the limited right to use it for the Purpose. This is mutual and reasonable.
items.quote: 8.1 **Confidential Information** remains the property of the Disclosing Party. No licence is granted except the limited right to use it for the Purpose.

items.finding: The remedies clause includes injunctive relief, which is mutual. However, there are no caps on remedies. This is mutual and reasonable.
items.quote: 9.1 Each Party acknowledges that damages may not be an adequate remedy for breach, and the Disclosing Party may seek injunctive relief in addition to other remedies available at law.

items.finding: There are no non-compete, non-solicit, or exclusivity covenants hidden in the NDA. The obligations are mutual and reasonable.
items.quote:
3.1 The Receiving Party shall: (a) use the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information only for the Purpose; (b) disclose it only to its employees, directors, professional advisers and subcontractors who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less protective than this Agreement; (c) protect it with at least reasonable care and no less care than it applies to its own confidential information; and (d) promptly notify the Disclosing Party of any unauthorised use or disclosure of which it becomes aware.
8.2 Neither Party is obliged to enter into any further agreement. Each Party remains free to work with third parties, provided it does not use or disclose the other Party's Confidential Information.

items.finding: The term of the NDA is mutual, with a two-year initial term and a three-year post-termination obligation. This is reasonable and mutual.
items.quote:
7.1 This Agreement remains in force for two (2) years from the Effective Date. Either Party may terminate it earlier on thirty (30) days' written notice.
7.2 Each Party's obligations under Clauses 3 to 6 continue for three (3) years after expiry or termination of this Agreement.
